name: FreeRTOS Blinky
description: Create a FreeRTOS project with a single blinking-LED task. Suitable as a starting point for RTOS-based development.
files_included:
**CMakeLists.txt:** Configuration file to build your project.
**main.c:** Entry point that starts the FreeRTOS scheduler.
**app/app_freertos.c:** Blinky task implementation.
**app/app_freertos.h:** Task declarations.
**config/FreeRTOSConfig.h:** FreeRTOS kernel configuration.
outputs:
**.hex:** Hexadecimal binary for MCU flashing.
**.bin:** Raw binary for various deployment options.
requirements: Requires the FreeRTOS package to be added via the Library Manager before building.
